rationale: Read-only probe for OpenCode V2 provider readiness. Verifies required capabilities for privacy-bounded P67 adapter execution without mutating configuration or persisting credentials.

noninteractive_execution.description: Provider must support fully automated execution without human interaction
verification: argv or structured configuration interface exists

explicit_identity.description: Provider, agent, and model identity must be explicitly retrievable
verification: provider name is documented or discoverable
agent/model selection is explicit in configuration or output
identity fields align with P67 pairing requirements

isolated_config.description: Configuration can be scoped to individual runs without global mutation
verification: per-run config files or environment variables are supported
global user configuration is not required for basic operation

instrumentation_feasibility.description: Provider emits or supports capturing structural events for neutral telemetry
verification: structured output format exists (JSON, logs), or

auth_readiness.description: Authentication/quota status can be verified without credentials in output
verification: readiness check exists (e.g., version command, status endpoint)
auth failure returns distinct error code/message
credentials are never echoed to stdout/stderr/logs

alignment_with_triage_contract.note: RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE maps to OPENCODE_NOT_FOUND or OPENCODE_VERSION_INCOMPATIBLE when OpenCode is the provider runtime

forbidden_mutations: no credential storage or automated login
proof_boundary: Capability verification only. Does not prove adapter implementation correctness or provider effectiveness.
